messages:
Avery: FYI discovered a bunch of broken fragment links after the site migration. clicking TOC entries jumps to top on prod.
Priya: saw that too. which docs are affected?
Avery: snippets and guides: `/docs/guides/private-deploy#network-ips`, `/docs/sdk/ts#usage-sample`, and `/docs/examples/embeddings#image-kv-cache` 
Sam: quick inspect: our slug generator behavior changed between mkdocs and docusaurus. parentheses, non-ascii and spaces are being normalized differently -> underscores vs hyphens.
Diego: confirmed. `KV Cache (prefix)` now becomes `kv_cache_prefix` instead of `kv-cache-prefix`. old external links and anchors break.
Avery: two short-term options: 1) add explicit client-side redirects for the high-traffic fragments, or 2) generate tiny HTML redirect pages from legacy fragments to new slugs.
Priya: prefer 2) since it scales. but for immediate mitigation add a couple of redirects in docusaurus config for the top traffic ones.
Sam: there's also a formatting problem: one code fence in `sdk/ts` has a leading space which the parser treats as indented code and attaches the fragment to the code block. that removed the `#usage-sample` heading from the slug.
Avery: great catch. small markdown errors are causing anchor drift too. can someone fix that snippet?
Diego: i'll patch the snippet and open a PR for the quick redirect entries: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/860 
Priya: i'll add a CI link-check job that verifies fragments too. using linkinator with `--fragments` should catch these before merge.
Sam: long-term: we should standardize slug rules or add a post-build normalizer that emits redirect pages for legacy fragment patterns. avoids a huge hardcoded list.
DocsBot: created ticket RW-1292 for post-build redirect generator (P2) - https://board.internal/issue/RW-1292
Avery: also we should communicate to partners about slug normalization. there's at least one external site linking `/docs#migrating-from-old-api`. it will need a redirect.
Diego: added that to the redirect PR and left comments for partner outreach.
Priya: summary of immediate actions: Diego -> merge small redirects PR; Sam -> add linkinator fragment check in CI; Avery -> audit GA top fragment 404s and post a list here. DocsBot -> track RW-1292.
Sam: local test command: `yarn docs:build && npx linkinator http://localhost:3000/docs --fragments`
Avery: staging deploy looks good for the redirects, fragments now resolve for the reported links. merging to main shortly.
DocsBot: deploy triggered for branch fix/fragment-redirects - build #5678
Priya: once main is live i'll run a crawl and then we can close RW-1292 or move it to backlog depending on progress.
Avery: thanks everyone. let's keep the slug linter idea in the backlog (RW-1293) so new headings don't accidentally create breaking slugs.
Diego: added RW-1293 for slug linting rules.
Priya: merging main -> prod deploy in 10m. will post results. :rocket:
DocsBot: prod deploy complete - build #5678 - fragments validated by smoke check
Avery: closing thread, great turnaround. :thumbsup:
